name: UpperTheory.V.PropA.powIn
source: ∀ (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (X : Type) [AddCommGroup X] [Module ℤ_[l] X] (w : Module.End ℤ_[l] X),
(∀ k n : ℕ, InPow k (w - 1) → InPow k (w ^ n - 1)) ∧ (InPow 1 (w - 1) → InPow 2 (w ^ l - 1)) := by
refine ⟨(∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, w ^ i) y, ?_⟩
refine ⟨y + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range l, (∑ j ∈ Finset.range i, w ^ j) y', ?_⟩
have hw : ∀ i, (w ^ i) y = y + (l : ℤ_[l]) • (∑ j ∈ Finset.range i, w ^ j) y' := by
have h0 : (w ^ i - 1) y = (∑ j ∈ Finset.range i, w ^ j) ((w - 1) y) := by
rw [← geom_sum_mul, Module.End.mul_apply, hy, map_smul, LinearMap.sum_apply]
show: For a module endomorphism w over the ℓ-adic integers, if w−1 has image in ℓᵏX then every power difference wⁿ−1 does too. If w−1 has image in ℓX then w raised to ℓ minus one has image in ℓ²X.
strategy: The geometric-sum factorization proves the first assertion. For the extra factor of ℓ in the second, sum the ℓ powers acting on a first divisibility witness, each congruent to that witness modulo ℓ.

steps.claim: Write $S_n=\sum_{i<n}w^i$, so $w^n-1=S_n(w-1)$. This preserves the image condition modulo $\ell^k$ for every $n$. At $n=\ell$, if $w$ is the identity modulo $\ell$, the sum has $\ell$ terms congruent to the identity and gives a second factor of $\ell$.

children.claim: If $(w-1)X\subseteq\ell^k X$, write $(w-1)x=\ell^k y$. The factorization and linearity give $(w^n-1)x=S_n(\ell^k y)=\ell^k S_n y$ for every $n$, including $n=0$.
children.snippet:
· intro k n H x
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := H x
    refine ⟨(∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, w ^ i) y, ?_⟩
    rw [← geom_sum_mul, Module.End.mul_apply, hy, map_smul]

children.claim: If $(w-1)X\subseteq\ell X$, choose $y,y'$ with $(w-1)x=\ell y$ and $(w-1)y=\ell y'$. Summing $w^i y=y+\ell S_i y'$ over $i<\ell$ yields $(w^\ell-1)x=\ell^2(y+\sum_{i<\ell} S_i y')$.
For $x\in X$, write $(w-1)x=\ell y$ and then $(w-1)y=\ell y'$ by the image hypothesis. The proposed witness for $(w^\ell-1)x\in\ell^2X$ is $y+\sum_{i<\ell}S_i y'$.
children.snippet:
· intro H x
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := H x
    obtain ⟨y', hy'⟩ := H y
    rw [pow_one] at hy hy'
    refine ⟨y + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range l, (∑ j ∈ Finset.range i, w ^ j) y', ?_⟩

children.claim: For every $i$, one has $w^i y=y+\ell S_i y'$. This follows by evaluating $w^i-1=S_i(w-1)$ at $y$ and using $(w-1)y=\ell y'$.
children.snippet:
have hw : ∀ i, (w ^ i) y = y + (l : ℤ_[l]) • (∑ j ∈ Finset.range i, w ^ j) y' := by
      intro i
children.typedFact: ∀ i, (w ^ i) y = y + (l : ℤ_[l]) • (∑ j ∈ Finset.range i, w ^ j) y'

children.snippet:
have h0 : (w ^ i - 1) y = (∑ j ∈ Finset.range i, w ^ j) ((w - 1) y) := by
        rw [← Module.End.mul_apply, geom_sum_mul]
children.typedFact: (w ^ i - 1) y = (∑ j ∈ Finset.range i, w ^ j) ((w - 1) y)

children.claim: Substituting $(w-1)y=\ell y'$ on the right gives $w^i y-y=\ell S_i y'$ by linearity. Adding $y$ gives the asserted formula for $w^i y$.
children.snippet:
rw [hy', map_smul] at h0
      rw [← h0, LinearMap.sub_apply, Module.End.one_apply, add_sub_cancel]

children.claim: Using $w^\ell-1=S_\ell(w-1)$ gives $(w^\ell-1)x=\ell\sum_{i<\ell}w^i y$. Inserting the formula for $w^i y$ and summing the $\ell$ copies of $y$ yields exactly $\ell^2(y+\sum_{i<\ell}S_i y')$.
children.snippet:
rw [← geom_sum_mul, Module.End.mul_apply, hy, map_smul, LinearMap.sum_apply]
    simp_rw [hw]
    rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range, ← Finset.smul_sum,
      ← Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul ℤ_[l], ← smul_add, pow_two, mul_smul]

chapterTitle: Twisted cokernels in a cyclotomic tower
